patch.value: GH-912 regression: restore atomic cross-owner seeded Plan creation

GitHub #912 reports a 2026.8.5 regression of GH-688: plan create persists the Plan before seeded steps hit ownership enforcement, leaving partial state. Restore one-transaction cross-owner seeded creation and retry safety.
Cross-owner plan create with multiple seeded steps commits the complete Plan or nothing; a failed enrichment leaves no item/history residue; safe retry and same-owner behavior are covered.
